dict.string: Jarvis detects the wake phrase on your Mac. If you select OpenAI Live, conversation audio is sent to OpenAI after activation. You can mute the microphone at any time.
Jarvis recognizes the wake phrase on your Mac. With the Apple voice path, commands are also transcribed locally.
Jarvis reads your schedule and changes events only in tasks you authorize.
Jarvis discovers and controls the Bluetooth lights you choose in Settings. Device pairing and lighting controls stay local to this Mac.
